description: Bug hunt 2026-11-28 P1: Protection paladin never cast Holy Shield because the permanent Retribution Aura is also a reflect effect; Holy Shield and the aura now both answer a hit.

edits.name: Holy Shield AI: the permanent Retribution Aura (reflect, whole fight) no longer blocks the cast; only an active Holy Shield does
Reflect: every reflect effect answers the hit (Retribution Aura and Holy Shield both, as their texts say), not only the first found
edits.old: const rfl = tgt.effects.find(function (f) { return f.kind === 'reflect'; }); if (rfl && tgt.hp > 0) damage(st, tgt, src, rfl.amt, { type: 'magic', refl: true, noCrit: true }); }
edits.new: tgt.effects.filter(function (f) { return f.kind === 'reflect'; }).forEach(function (rfl) { if (tgt.hp > 0 && src.hp > 0) damage(st, tgt, src, rfl.amt, { type: 'magic', refl: true, noCrit: true }); }); }
